title: The big idea
text: cs_packetize() atomizes schema short ASCII tokens. one unquoted CSV cell: type--index id, payload, CRC-32, wrapped {{ }}. Packet S0 header (carries whole-schema hash); S1–S4 fields; last table packet primary key. packets copied spread across rows _schema column. surviving subset rows contains one copy enough rebuild schema.

title: The big idea
text: design separates three problems TCP/IP , solves two way. third , something else. schema atomized CRC-checked packets, copied striped across _schema cells different routes; packets mangled whose rows deleted fail CRC dropped, surviving copies deduplicated reassembled, whole-schema hash confirms result.

what: 1. Fragmentation metadata — which piece, and how many?
title: The big idea

IP fragment carries identification number, offset, -fragments flag. csvschema packet carries S/

what: 2. Per-piece integrity — is this piece intact?
title: The big idea
text: Every IP/TCP/UDP header checksum; Ethernet frames CRC-32. receiver recomputes , mismatch, discards piece. csvschema packet ends CRC-32 id~payload. read, packet fails dropped exactly row deleted: garbled copy dead end diagram; intact copy carries packet, schema still rebuilds. packet column holds many copies, die matter:
code: pk <- cs_packetize(s) tampered <- pk[3] substr(tampered, 12, 12) <- "X"          # a spreadsheet, or find-and-replace parsed <- cs_parse_packets(c(pk[3], tampered)) parsed[, c("type", "index", "crc_ok")] #>   type index crc_ok #> 1    s     2   TRUE #> 2    s     2  FALSE # the real file keeps lots of copies, so recovery is unaffected tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".csv") cs_write(ex, tmp, sidecar = FALSE, verbose = FALSE) cs_report(cs_read_csv(tmp, verbose = FALSE))$status #> [1] "verified"

what: 3. Whole-object verification — is the reassembled thing the right thing?
title: The big idea
text: BitTorrent client checks piece info-hash whole file, pieces collected many peers still assemble exactly published file. Packet S0 carries hash canonical schema text; cs_recover() recomputes reassembly. mismatch means version mixing — two different schemas bound together — reported, accepted.

what: Is the corruption check the handshake?
title: The big idea
text: quite — difference whole point. TCP’s handshake resend garbled datagrams (loop classic diagram) need two-way conversation: receiver tells sender arrived, sender retransmits rest. CSV file one-way broadcast — read long written, someone ask resend. csvschema keeps halves idea work without back-channel: CRC-32 packet per-datagram checksum — detects garbled packet drops . “piece intact?” check, handshake. way request resend, sends many copies front instead — forward error correction repetition, like PAR2 blocks Usenet redundancy QR code. redundancy math sizes many copies survive given fraction row loss. whole-schema hash final “right thing?” check, like BitTorrent’s info-hash. Detection redundancy, computed frozen file; conversation required.

what: A packet is one ASCII token
title: Design: the wire format and the redundancy math
text: Every piece schema single unquoted token form {{<id>~<payload>~<crc>}}. comma, semicolon, tab, pipe, quote, newline, whitespace appears inside , CSV dialect ever needs quote delimiter rewriting can change . Non-ASCII bytes percent-encoded spaces become +: actual packets small schema: Packet S0 header (wire version, encoding, dialect, field count, row count, MTU, whole-schema hash). Packets S1..Sn fields column order, last schema packet carries table-level properties primary key. packet’s attribute keys map one--one onto Frictionless Table Schema v2 field properties, sidecar packets two encodings model.
code: cs_encode_token("Public charity") #> [1] "Public+charity" cs_encode_token("Café") #> [1] "Caf%C3%A9" s <- cs_schema(   data.frame(ein = "001234567", year = 2020L, rev = 1.5,              org = factor("Public charity"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE),   primary_key = "ein",   overrides = list(ein = list(constraints = list(pattern = "^[0-9]{9}$",                                                  unique = TRUE))) ) writeLines(cs_packetize(s, mtu = 200)) #> {{S0/6~cs=1^enc=utf-8^dialect=rfc4180^fields=4^rows=1^mtu=200^hash=5a946b1530b8~231d3cf8}} #> {{S1/6~ein^str^pat=%5E%5B0-9%5D%7B9%7D%24^uniq~935ecb9f}} #> {{S2/6~year^int~e127d914}} #> {{S3/6~rev^num~86934540}} #> {{S4/6~org^str^lev=Public+charity~694de026}} #> {{S5/6~pk=ein~111401d0}}

text: packet carries index total count, rather last-piece flag, flag fails last piece one lost. packet ends CRC-32 id~payload; packet fails dropped row deleted. reassembly, whole-schema hash packet 0 recomputed — plausible mix two schema versions rejected even though every individual packet valid.

title: Design: the wire format and the redundancy math
text: Repetition coding makes survival coupon-collector problem. fraction f rows kept random packet r independent copies, union bound P packets gives minimum copies ceiling( ln(P / eps) / -ln(1 - f) ), cs_copies() computes: cs_redundancy() turns required r concrete layout — number schema columns c packets per cell p — preferring extra packets per cell (invisible) extra columns, cs_survival() reports achieved failure probability layout:
code: f <- c(0.50, 0.20, 0.10, 0.05, 0.01) data.frame(   retained = f,   copies   = vapply(f, function(fi) cs_copies(20, fi, eps = 1e-6), integer(1)) ) #>   retained copies #> 1     0.50     25 #> 2     0.20     76 #> 3     0.10    160 #> 4     0.05    328 #> 5     0.01   1673 cs_redundancy(20, 2000, f = 0.2)$sentence #> [1] "survives random loss of 80% of rows with failure probability 4.1e-09" cs_survival(20, 2000, c = 1, p = 1, f = 0.2) #> [1] 4.074072e-09

title: Design: the wire format and the redundancy math
text: Random row loss easy case. Structured loss — head(), page paginated export, systematic every-k-th sample — handled deterministic rotating stripe, packets spread rather clustered. cs_stripe() pure arithmetic, reproducible testable: stripe guarantees first P rows contain every packet (head() recovers), 2P - 1 consecutive rows , full read , systematic every-P-th-row sample cycles packets. single period-P stripe also guarantee every arbitrary strided sample first P terms — mathematically incompatible contiguous guarantee — heavy arbitrary strides rely redundancy r, stripe.

title: Design: the wire format and the redundancy math
text: Three limits worth stating plainly: Deleting every _schema column removes -band schema entirely. Use sidecar (cs_write(..., sidecar = TRUE)), independent, accept file reads back character columns status = "absent". Case-folding every cell detected, recovered: per-packet CRC covers exact-case payload, folded payloads fail dropped. NA versus "": default missingValues = [""], empty cell reads back NA; two indistinguishable written na = "". Numeric values written R’s default precision. Erasure coding (recover fewer surviving rows destroy human readability add dependency) reserved future version; E packet type left unused .

title: csvschema 0.1.0
text: First release. Built bottom-design brief. Codec (encode.R): percent-encoding pure-ASCII, separator-safe token form (cs_encode_token()/cs_decode_token()) cs_crc32(). Schema model (schema.R): cs_schema() data frames (factors, ordered factors, haven::labelled, Date, POSIXct, integer/double, logical, character), one--one mapping Frictionless Table Schema v2, lossless conversion ways, cs_to_coltypes() / cs_to_readr_spec(). Wire format (packetize.R, parse.R): cs_packetize() deterministic first-fit fragmentation, cs_parse_packets(), cs_recover() four statuses (verified, conflict, incomplete, absent), per-packet CRC-32 whole-schema SHA-1. Layout (layout.R): redundancy math (cs_copies(), cs_redundancy(), cs_survival()) reproducible rotating stripe (cs_stripe(), cs_lay()). Canary (canary.R): purposeful value sampler, canary packets, two-level check (cs_canary_check()) names kind data damage. /O (io_write.R, io_read.R): cs_write() cs_read_csv(), column detection content, schema application, Frictionless datapackage.json sidecar cross-hashes. Simulators (corrupt.R): cs_corrupt_*() family, one per threat-model vector. Reporting (report.R): cs_report object, one-line summaries tables. Specification (inst/specs/wire-format.md): normative, language-independent description wire format. Compatibility matrix (inst/compat/): 2,000-row fixture round-tripped scriptable CSV tools (base R, readr, data.table, arrow, vroom, line-based subsets), per-tool recovery canary results; regenerate data-raw/make_compat.R. Documentation site: pkgdown site (NODC pkgstyle template) hosted main/docs, four vignettes — “big idea” (internet-packet metaphor end end), quick start, corruption, design.

title: csvschema 0.1.0
text: package name csvschema API prefix cs_ (brief used working name schemaless / sl_). rotating stripe guarantees recovery head()/prefix, window least 2P - 1 consecutive rows, full-file reads, systematic every-P-th-row sample. single period-P stripe also guarantee every arbitrary strided sample first P terms; heavy arbitrary strides rely redundancy r, stripe. Case folding every cell detected, recovered: per-packet CRC covers exact-case payload, folded payloads fail CRC dropped. Recovery reports loss rather returning silently wrong schema. default missingValues = [""], empty cell reads back NA; "" NA indistinguishable written na = "". Two vectors mitigated -band: deletion every schema column, bit-level damage compressed container.
